_about: Public-domain George Hodges (1856-1919), Episcopal priest and Dean of the Episcopal Theological School, Cambridge, Massachusetts, for the Word Hoard: his sermons and essays (Christianity between Sundays, The Heresy of Cain, The Human Nature of the Saints, The Battles of Peace, Everyman's Religion), church history (Fountains Abbey, Three Hundred Years of the Episcopal Church in America, Saints and Heroes, The Early Church), Bible stories and guides for children, and his life of Bishop Henry Codman Potter. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 86 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
